adopts_by_binding.missing_data_policy: rejudge/phase2_missing_data_policy_proposal_2026-08-04.json is hash-bound into this manifest's governance block, so authorizing this identity adopts it. Its substance is mostly already pre-registered; what is new is the disposition for cells that produce no row (they count INVALID, which counts wrong) and three ex-ante gates: 1.0% overall incompletion, 0.5pp differential between the three primary conditions, and 1.0% batch parent loss. Those three numbers are a judgement call calibrated on the first canary's 0.27% terminal-halt rate.

known_deviations_carried_forward: The reviewer is gpt-5.6-sol at high effort, not the originally pinned claude-fable-5, under the 2026-08-01 substitution record. Unlike the first canary this run is homogeneous: one reviewer throughout, not a mixture.
Role limits v6 (120s read timeout) under the 2026-08-01 transport amendment.
note: Append-only. Records the basis for an authorization; the authorization itself is a separate record naming the identity hash.

spend.basis: the 2026-07-28 canary settled at $6.58 for the same 945 cells, and the fresh cache means nothing is inherited, so this run pays for its calls again.
spend.unmanifested_spend: none. The concurrency ramp runs cells OF THIS PLAN rather than a synthetic probe, so every call is inside this manifest.

subject: bridge canary on the corrected, concurrent pipeline
what_changed_since_the_first_canary: Defect A fixed: the single-call path (batch replay, full-document, empty-evidence) hardcoded position_a_is_correct=True and was therefore never counterbalanced. 98 canary cells affected, 95 of them batch_same_qa_b2, which is a primary-test condition.

Defect B fixed: the dual gate was handed candidate_a/candidate_b from that same literal while the judge read the counterbalanced order. Measured across all 332 gated cells with zero exceptions, the 224 with polarity False had the labels swapped.
Single-call rows now go through records.build_record, so they carry position_a_is_correct, transcript_index and verdict_correct_*; previously they could not be scored from their own contents.

Singleflight in the dual-gate decision store, plus locks in all three hash-chained stores. Before this, 8 workers on one payload produced 8 reviewer calls and a fatal commit collision, and 12 workers racing one cell key ALL succeeded in claiming it.
Concurrent runner with condition-balanced deterministic blocks and per-model caps.
what_this_does_not_authorize: the main run. This canary is a validation of the corrected pipeline, not a measurement of the scientific question, and its questions are the 24 held out from the main grid.
why_a_second_canary: The 2026-07-28 canary validated a DEFECTIVE, SERIAL implementation. The main run would use a corrected, concurrent one, so two of the three things it would exercise have never run live. At roughly $7 a canary this cannot be declined on cost.
